question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Dissolve".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Appear.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Dissolve" means to mix with a liquid and become part of the solution. (घुलना)

◦ Example: Sugar will dissolve more quickly in hot water than in cold water.

 

• "Appear" means to become visible or come into sight, and is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रकट होना)

◦ Example: A rainbow suddenly appeared in the sky after the brief afternoon shower.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Liquefy (तरल होना): to make or become liquid — a synonym of dissolve, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Melt (पिघलना): to change from solid to liquid by heat — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Disintegrate (विघटित होना): to break up into small parts — close in sense to dissolve.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of dissolve: Melt, Disintegrate, Liquefy, Dissipate, Vanish.

• Synonyms of appear: Emerge, Materialize, Surface, Show, Arise.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Prosperity (समृद्धि): Poverty (गरीबी), Failure (असफलता)

2. Prudent (समझदार): Thoughtless (अविवेकी), Careless (लापरवाह)

3. Puissant (शक्तिशाली): Feeble (कमजोर), Weak (दुर्बल)

4. Pulchritude (सुंदरता): Ugliness (कुरूपता), Plainness (साधारणता)

5. Pulverize (चूर्ण करना): Restore (पुनः स्थापित करना), Repair (मरम्मत करना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Influenced".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Bipartisan.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Influenced" means affected or guided by the opinion or action of another. (प्रभावित)

◦ Example: The jury's verdict appeared to be influenced by media coverage that circulated widely before the trial began.

 

• "Bipartisan" means supported by or involving members of two opposing political parties, and is therefore the correct antonym. (द्विपक्षीय/निष्पक्ष)

◦ Example: The bipartisan committee worked together across party lines to draft immigration reforms acceptable to both sides.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Affected (प्रभावित): changed or influenced by something — a synonym of influenced, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Swayed (झुकाया गया): persuaded to change an opinion — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Persuaded (राजी किया गया): convinced to do or believe something — close in sense to influenced.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of influenced: Affected, Swayed, Persuaded, Shaped, Guided.

• Synonyms of bipartisan: Nonpartisan, Impartial, Unbiased, Neutral.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Purify (शुद्ध करना): Pollute (प्रदूषित करना), Contaminate (दूषित करना)

2. Purportedly (कथित रूप से): Impossibly (असंभव रूप से)

3. Pusillanimous (कायर): Brave (साहसी), Courageous (वीर)

4. Quaint (अनोखा / प्यारा): Ordinary (सामान्य), Common (साधारण)

5. Quell (दबाना): Provoke (भड़काना), Agitate (उत्तेजित करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Nonchalant."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Considerate.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Nonchalant" means feeling or appearing casually calm and unconcerned. (उदासीन)

 

• "Considerate" means careful not to cause inconvenience or hurt to others; thoughtful. It is therefore the correct antonym. (विचारशील)

◦ Example: The considerate host made sure every guest with dietary restrictions had something suitable to eat.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Unconcerned (निश्चिंत) — not feeling worry or interest; a synonym of nonchalant.

• Option 2: Indifferent (उदासीन) — having no particular interest; a synonym of nonchalant.

• Option 4: Blasé (उदासीन) — unimpressed due to overfamiliarity; a synonym of nonchalant.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of nonchalant: Concerned, Thoughtful, Attentive.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Quixotic (अव्यावहारिक): Pragmatic (व्यावहारिक), Realistic (यथार्थवादी)

2. Rampart (किले की दीवार): Ditch (खाई), Opening (खुला स्थान)

3. Random (अनियमित): Systematic (सुव्यवस्थित), Planned (योजनाबद्ध)

4. Ravaged (विनष्ट): Restored (पुनःस्थापित)

5. Rebarbative (अप्रिय / अरुचिकर): Attractive (आकर्षक), Pleasant (सुखद)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Concede."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Deny.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Concede" means admit that something is true after first denying it. (स्वीकार करना)

 

• "Deny" means state that something is not true. It is therefore the correct antonym. (नकारना)

◦ Example: The company continued to deny any responsibility for the pollution caused by its factories.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Admit (स्वीकार करना) — confess something to be true; a synonym of concede.

• Option 3: Accept (स्वीकार करना) — agree to receive or believe; a synonym of concede.

• Option 4: Acknowledge (स्वीकार करना) — accept or admit the existence of; a synonym of concede.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of concede: Refute, Reject, Contradict.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Rebellion (विद्रोह): Loyalty (निष्ठा)

2. Recalcitrance (अवज्ञा): Compliance (आज्ञापालन), Obedience (आज्ञाकारिता)

3. Receive (प्राप्त करना): Give (देना), Send (भेजना)

4. Recount (बयान करना): Suppress (दबाना), Conceal (छिपाना)

5. Rectify (सुधारना): Worsen (बिगाड़ना), Damage (हानि करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Recount."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Suppress.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Recount" means to narrate or tell in detail. (बयान करना)

 

• "Suppress" means to prevent something from being known or expressed. It is therefore the correct antonym. (दबाना)

◦ Example: The government tried to suppress news of the scandal before it reached the national press.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Relate (बताना) — to give an account of; narrate; a synonym of recount.

• Option 3: Narrate (वर्णन करना) — to give a spoken or written account of something; a synonym of recount.

• Option 4: Detail (विस्तार से बताना) — to describe fully, giving all facts; a synonym of recount.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of recount: Conceal, Withhold, Hide.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Redeem (सुधारना): Forfeit (गंवाना), Ruin (बर्बाद करना)

2. Redolent (सुगंधित): Unscented (बिना गंध), Odorless (गंधहीन)

3. Refulgent (चमकदार): Dull (फीका), Dim (मंद)

4. Refuse (मना करना): Accept (स्वीकार करना), Permit (अनुमति देना)

5. Relevant (प्रासंगिक): Inappropriate (अनुचित)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Felicitous."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Unfortunate.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Felicitous" means well suited for a particular occasion; apt or fortunate. (उपयुक्त)

 

• "Unfortunate" means having or marked by bad luck; unlucky. It is therefore the correct antonym. (दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण)

◦ Example: An unfortunate series of delays caused the team to miss their connecting flight and important meeting.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Fitting (उचित) — appropriate to a particular situation; a synonym of felicitous.

• Option 3: Apt (उपयुक्त) — suitable in the circumstances; a synonym of felicitous.

• Option 4: Appropriate (मुनासिब) — suitable or proper for the occasion; a synonym of felicitous.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of felicitous: Inappropriate, Unlucky, Untimely.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Relinquish (त्यागना): Retain (रखना), Continue (जारी रखना)

2. Reluctant (अनिच्छुक): Enthusiastic (उत्साही), Willing (तैयार)

3. Reprobate (अनैतिक व्यक्ति): Virtuous (सदाचारी), Moral (नैतिक)

4. Repudiate (त्यागना): Accept (स्वीकार करना), Approve (मंजूरी देना)

5. Repulsive (घृणित): Pleasant (सुखद)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Less."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. More.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Less" means a smaller amount or degree of something. (कम)

 

• "More" means a greater or additional amount or degree of something. It is therefore the correct antonym. (अधिक)

◦ Example: The manager asked the team to spend more time reviewing the report before submitting it to the client.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Lesser (छोटा) — smaller in size, amount, or degree; a synonym of less.

• Option 3: Reduced (घटाया हुआ) — made smaller in amount or size; a synonym of less.

• Option 4: Fewer (कम) — a smaller number of things; a synonym of less.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of less: Plenty, Greater, Extra.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Resilient (मजबूत): Fragile (नाजुक), Weak (कमजोर)

2. Retired (सेवानिवृत्त): Active (सक्रिय), Working (कार्यरत)

3. Reverence (सम्मान): Contempt (तिरस्कार), Scorn (घृणा)

4. Risible (हंसने योग्य): Serious (गंभीर), Grave (गंभीर)

5. Rowdy (उपद्रवी): Compliant (आज्ञाकारी), Calm (शांत)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Admire".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Despise.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Admire" means to regard someone or something with respect and warm approval. (प्रशंसा करना)

◦ Example: Colleagues across the industry admire her relentless dedication to fair and ethical business practices.

 

• "Despise" means to feel contempt or a deep dislike for someone, and is therefore the correct antonym. (घृणा करना)

◦ Example: The villagers came to despise the corrupt official who had exploited them for years.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Esteem (सम्मान करना): to regard someone with great respect — a synonym of admire, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Respect (आदर करना): to feel or show esteem for someone — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Revere (श्रद्धा करना): to feel deep respect or veneration — close in sense to admire.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of admire: Respect, Esteem, Revere, Appreciate, Cherish.

• Synonyms of despise: Hate, Detest, Loathe, Scorn, Disdain.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ruthless (निर्दयी): Compassionate (दयालु), Kind (कृपालु)

2. Sagacious (बुद्धिमान): Foolish (मूर्ख), Unwise (अविवेकी)

3. Sanguine (आशावादी): Melancholic (निराश), Pessimistic (निराशावादी)

4. Scared (डरा हुआ): Brave (साहसी), Fearless (निर्भय)

5. Scary (डरावना): Comforting (सांत्वनादायक), Reassuring (आश्वस्त करने वाला)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Happy".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Sad.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Happy" means feeling or showing pleasure, contentment, or joy. (खुश)

◦ Example: The children were happy to receive new toys during the festival celebrations at home.

 

• "Sad" means feeling or showing sorrow, unhappiness, or grief, and is therefore the correct antonym. (दुखी)

◦ Example: She felt sad after learning that her closest friend was moving abroad permanently.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Delighted (अत्यंत प्रसन्न): feeling great pleasure or satisfaction — a synonym of happy, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Joyful (आनंदित): feeling or expressing great happiness — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Cheerful (प्रसन्न): noticeably happy and optimistic in mood — close in sense to happy.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of happy: Joyful, Cheerful, Delighted, Content, Pleased.

• Synonyms of sad: Unhappy, Sorrowful, Gloomy, Miserable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Scattered (बिखरा): Gathered (इकट्ठा), Collected (संग्रहित)

2. Scrupulous (ईमानदार / नैतिक): Immoral (अनैतिक), Dishonest (बेईमान)

3. Searing (जलाना/तेज़ गर्म): Freezing (जमाने वाला/ठंडा), Cold (ठंडा)

4. Secure (सुरक्षित): Insecure (असुरक्षित), Unsafe (असुरक्षित)

5. Seldom (कभी-कभी): Frequently (अक्सर), Often (बार-बार)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Cacophony."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Harmony.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Cacophony" means a harsh, jarring mixture of discordant sounds; noise. (शोर)

 

• "Harmony" means the combination of simultaneous musical notes to produce a pleasing effect. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सामंजस्य)

◦ Example: The choir sang in perfect harmony, blending their voices into one smooth and pleasing sound.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Uproar (हंगामा) — a loud and impassioned noise or disturbance; a synonym of cacophony.

• Option 3: Noise (शोर) — a loud or unpleasant sound; a synonym of cacophony.

• Option 4: Clamor (चीख-पुकार) — a loud and confused noise, especially of shouting; a synonym of cacophony.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of cacophony: Melody, Concord, Unison.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Selective (चयनशील): Careless (लापरवाह), Indiscriminate (भेदभाव रहित)

2. Sell (बेचना): Buy (खरीदना), Purchase (खरीदना)

3. Serene (शांत): Chaotic (अशांत), Turbulent (उथल-पुथल)

4. Servile (चापलूस): Arrogant (घमंडी), Independent (स्वतंत्र)

5. Shallow (उथला): Deep (गहरा)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Eminent."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Obscure.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Eminent" means famous and respected within a particular field or profession. (प्रसिद्ध)

 

• "Obscure" means not well known; not discovered or clearly understood. It is therefore the correct antonym. (अज्ञात)

◦ Example: Despite his talent, the artist remained obscure until his work was discovered decades after his death.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Illustrious (यशस्वी) — well known and admired for past achievements; a synonym of eminent.

• Option 2: Distinguished (प्रतिष्ठित) — successful and commanding respect; a synonym of eminent.

• Option 4: Renowned (प्रसिद्ध) — famous and respected; a synonym of eminent.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of eminent: Unknown, Ordinary, Inconspicuous.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Shrink (सिकुड़ना): Expand (फैलना), Grow (बढ़ना)

2. Slander (बदनाम करना): Praise (प्रशंसा), Appreciate (सराहना)

3. Slender (पतला): Stout (मोटा), Thick (मोटा)

4. Sloppy (मैला/लापरवाह): Dashing (सजावटी/स्मार्ट), Neat (साफ-सुथरा)

5. Sluggish (सुस्त): Active (सक्रिय), Energetic (ऊर्जावान)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Intentional".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Unplanned.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Intentional" means done on purpose; deliberate and planned rather than accidental. (जानबूझकर)

◦ Example: The referee ruled that the foul was intentional and issued the player a yellow card immediately.

 

• "Unplanned" means not planned or intended; happening by chance, and is therefore the correct antonym. (अनायास)

◦ Example: The merger turned out to be largely unplanned, arising from a sudden opportunity neither company had anticipated.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Calculated (सोच-समझकर किया गया): done with careful thought beforehand — a synonym of intentional, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Purposeful (उद्देश्यपूर्ण): having a clear aim or intention — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Deliberate (जानबूझकर): done consciously and intentionally — close in sense to intentional.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of intentional: Deliberate, Purposeful, Calculated, Premeditated, Willful.

• Synonyms of unplanned: Accidental, Unintentional, Spontaneous, Incidental.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Sneer (उपहास करना): Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Respect (सम्मान करना)

2. Solicit (मदद माँगना): Prohibit (मना करना), Forbid (प्रतिबंध लगाना)

3. Somnolent (निद्रालु): Awake (जाग्रत), Alert (सतर्क)

4. Sophisticated (उन्नत): Primitive (आदिम), Simple (सरल)

5. Soporific (नींद लाने वाला): Stimulating (उत्तेजक), Energizing (ऊर्जावान)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Dominate".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Submit.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Dominate" means to have a controlling influence or power over someone or something. (शासन करना)

◦ Example: The champion team continued to dominate the league, winning every match with ease this season.

 

• "Submit" means to accept or yield to the authority or will of another, and is therefore the correct antonym. (आत्मसमर्पण करना)

◦ Example: Rather than fight the decision, the employee chose to submit to the manager's final ruling.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Rule (शासन करना): to exercise governing power over — a synonym of dominate, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Control (नियंत्रित करना): to have power over something — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Overpower (पराजित करना): to defeat by superior strength — close in sense to dominate.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of dominate: Control, Rule, Overpower, Command, Govern.

• Synonyms of submit: Yield, Surrender, Obey, Comply, Capitulate.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Sporadic (अनियमित): Frequent (बार-बार), Regular (नियमित)

2. Spurious (नकली): Authentic (असली), Genuine (वास्तविक)

3. Squirm (घबराना/बेचैन होना): Relax (आराम करना), Calm (शांत रहना)

4. Stale (बासी): Fresh (ताज़ा), New (नया)

5. Staunch (दृढ़): Unsteady (अस्थिर), Weak (कमज़ोर)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Advanced".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Rudimentary.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Advanced" means far ahead in development, skill, or technology. (उन्नत)

◦ Example: The laboratory uses advanced imaging equipment capable of detecting tumors at an early stage.

 

• "Rudimentary" means basic or fundamental; not fully developed, and is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रारंभिक)

◦ Example: The village still relied on rudimentary tools for farming despite nearby industrial development.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Sophisticated (परिष्कृत): highly developed and complex — a synonym of advanced, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Cutting-edge (अत्याधुनिक): most modern or advanced — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Progressive (प्रगतिशील): happening or developing gradually toward improvement — close in sense to advanced.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of advanced: Sophisticated, Cutting-edge, Progressive, Modern, Innovative.

• Synonyms of rudimentary: Basic, Elementary, Primitive, Simple, Crude.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Strange (अजीब): Mundane (साधारण), Familiar (परिचित)

2. Strenuous (कठिन/जोरदार): Easy (आसान), Effortless (सरल)

3. Strong (मजबूत): Weak (कमजोर), Fragile (नाजुक)

4. Stunning (आश्चर्यजनक): Mundane (साधारण), Ordinary (सामान्य)

5. Sublime (उत्कृष्ट): Mediocre (साधारण), Inferior (निम्न)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Lethargic."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Active.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Lethargic" means lacking energy; sluggish and drowsy. (सुस्त)

 

• "Active" means engaging or ready to engage in physically energetic pursuits. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सक्रिय)

◦ Example: The children remained active all afternoon, running around the park despite the scorching summer heat.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Sluggish (सुस्त) — slow-moving and lacking energy; a synonym of lethargic.

• Option 2: Drowsy (उनींदा) — sleepy and lacking alertness; a synonym of lethargic.

• Option 4: Languid (शिथिल) — lacking energy or vitality; a synonym of lethargic.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of lethargic: Energetic, Lively, Vigorous.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Subterfuge (छल): Candor (स्पष्टवादिता), Honesty (ईमानदारी)

2. Success (सफलता): Failure (असफलता), Defeat (पराजय)

3. Superficial (सतही): Profound (गहरा), Deep (गंभीर)

4. Superfluous (अनावश्यक / फालतू): Essential (आवश्यक), Necessary (जरूरी)

5. Suppress (दबाना): Incite (उकसाना), Reveal (प्रकट करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Superficial."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Profound.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Superficial" means existing or occurring at or on the surface; not thorough. (सतही)

 

• "Profound" means very great or intense; showing deep understanding. It is therefore the correct antonym. (गहरा)

◦ Example: The philosopher's profound insights into human nature influenced generations of thinkers.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Skin-deep (सतही) — affecting only the surface; a synonym of superficial.

• Option 2: Cursory (सरसरी) — done quickly without attention to detail; a synonym of superficial.

• Option 4: Shallow (उथला) — lacking depth of thought or feeling; a synonym of superficial.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of superficial: Deep, Thorough, Intense.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Surreptitious (गुप्त): Overt (खुला), Open (स्पष्ट)

2. Sustainability (स्थिरता): Indefensibility (अस्थिरता/असुरक्षित स्थिति)

3. Sustenance (जीविका): Starvation (भूखमरी), Deprivation (वंचना)

4. Sweet (मीठा): Bitter (कड़वा), Sour (खट्टा)

5. Synthetic (कृत्रिम): Natural (प्राकृतिक), Genuine (वास्तविक)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Laudable."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Deplorable.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Laudable" means deserving praise and commendation for one's actions or conduct. (प्रशंसनीय)

 

• "Deplorable" means deserving strong condemnation; shockingly bad. It is therefore the correct antonym. (निंदनीय)

◦ Example: The living conditions in the overcrowded shelter were deplorable and drew widespread criticism from human rights groups.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Commendable (सराहनीय) — deserving praise or approval; a synonym of laudable.

• Option 3: Meritorious (गुणी) — deserving reward or praise; a synonym of laudable.

• Option 4: Praiseworthy (प्रशंसनीय) — deserving admiration and approval; a synonym of laudable.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of laudable: Shameful, Disgraceful, Reprehensible.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Taboo (वर्जित): Acceptable (स्वीकृत)

2. Tacit (अव्यक्त): Explicit (स्पष्ट), Expressed (प्रकट)

3. Taciturn (कम बोलने वाला): Talkative (बातूनी), Verbose (अधिक बोलने वाला)

4. Tangible (मूर्त): Intangible (अमूर्त), Abstract (अव्यक्त)

5. Tardy (सुस्त/देरी से): Prompt (समय पर), Quick (तेज)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Modest".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Conceited.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Modest" means having a moderate or humble estimate of one's own abilities. (विनम्र)

◦ Example: Despite winning the award, she remained modest, insisting the entire team deserved equal credit.

 

• "Conceited" means excessively proud of oneself; vain, and is therefore the correct antonym. (घमंडी)

◦ Example: His conceited remarks about his own talent quickly alienated the rest of the study group.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Meek (नम्र): quiet and humble in manner — a synonym of modest, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Humble (विनम्र): having a modest opinion of oneself — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Unassuming (निरभिमानी): not seeking attention; modest — close in sense to modest.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of modest: Humble, Unassuming, Meek, Reserved, Unpretentious.

• Synonyms of conceited: Vain, Arrogant, Boastful, Proud.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Tedious (उबाऊ / थकाऊ): Exciting (रोचक), Engaging (आकर्षक)

2. Tenacious (जिद्दी / दृढ़): Yielding (झुकने वाला), Weak (कमजोर)

3. Tenebrous (अंधकारमय): Bright (उज्ज्वल), Clear (स्पष्ट)

4. Thwart (विफल करना): Assist (सहायता करना), Help (मदद करना)

5. Timid (डरपोक): Daring (साहसी), Bold (निडर)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Despair".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Hope.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Despair" means the complete loss or absence of hope. (निराशा)

◦ Example: Years of unrelenting drought pushed many farmers in the region toward deep despair and financial ruin.

 

• "Hope" means a feeling of expectation and desire for a particular outcome, and is therefore the correct antonym. (आशा)

◦ Example: Even after the setback, the young athlete never lost hope of representing her country at the Olympics.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Hopelessness (निराशा): the state of having no hope — a synonym of despair, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Anguish (पीड़ा): severe mental or emotional suffering — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Desperation (बेबसी): a state of despair and recklessness — close in sense to despair.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of despair: hopelessness, desperation, anguish, gloom, misery.

• Synonyms of hope: optimism, expectation, aspiration, faith.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Torpor (सुस्ती): Liveliness (सजीवता), Activity (सक्रियता)

2. Traditional (परम्परागत): Modern (आधुनिक), Unusual (असामान्य)

3. Traitor (देशद्रोही): Loyal (वफादार), Patriot (देशभक्त)

4. Transient (क्षणिक): Permanent (स्थायी), Lasting (दीर्घकालिक)

5. Transitory (अस्थायी): Eternal (स्थायी), Permanent (स्थायी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Dismal."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Lively.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Dismal" means causing a feeling of gloom or depression; dreary. (निराशाजनक)

 

• "Lively" means full of energy, activity, and enthusiasm. It is therefore the correct antonym. (जीवंत)

◦ Example: The market was filled with lively vendors calling out prices and haggling with customers.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Dreary (नीरस) — dull, bleak, and lifeless; a synonym of dismal.

• Option 2: Bleak (निराशाजनक) — lacking hope or encouragement; a synonym of dismal.

• Option 3: Gloomy (उदास) — dark and depressing; a synonym of dismal.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of dismal: Cheerful, Vibrant, Bright.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Trepidation (घबराहट): Calm (शांत), Relaxed (आरामदायक)

2. Triumph (विजय): Defeat (पराजय), Failure (असफलता)

3. Triumphant (विजयी): Defeated (पराजित), Unsuccessful (असफल)

4. Trivial (तुच्छ): Important (महत्वपूर्ण), Significant (जरूरी)

5. Truculent (लड़ाकू): Amiable (मिलनसार), Amicable (मैत्रीपूर्ण)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Persuade."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Dissuade.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Persuade" means to induce someone to do something through reasoning or argument. (मनाना)

 

• "Dissuade" means to convince someone not to take a particular course of action. It is therefore the correct antonym. (हतोत्साहित करना)

◦ Example: Her parents tried to dissuade her from quitting her stable job to start a risky business.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Coax (फुसलाना) — to persuade gently through gentle urging; a synonym of persuade.

• Option 3: Induce (प्रेरित करना) — to succeed in persuading someone to act; a synonym of persuade.

• Option 4: Convince (विश्वास दिलाना) — to cause someone to believe or agree; a synonym of persuade.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of persuade: Prevent, Halt, Deter.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Tumult (शोर-शराबा): Calmness (शांति), Silence (मौन)

2. Turbulent (अशांत): Calm (शांत), Peaceful (सुकून भरा)

3. Turpitude (अनैतिकता): Morality (नैतिकता), Virtue (सदाचार)

4. Uncomfortable (असुविधाजनक): Comfortable (आरामदायक), Easy (सहज)

5. Undesirable (अवांछनीय): Advisable (उचित)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Falter."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Persist.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Falter" means to lose strength or momentum; hesitate or stumble. (हिचकना)

 

• "Persist" means to continue firmly despite difficulty or opposition. It is therefore the correct antonym. (दृढ़ रहना)

◦ Example: Despite repeated setbacks, the young entrepreneur chose to persist with her business plan until it finally succeeded.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Hesitate (हिचकिचाना) — to pause before saying or doing something; a synonym of falter.

• Option 3: Waver (डगमगाना) — to become unsteady; show indecision; a synonym of falter.

• Option 4: Stumble (लड़खड़ाना) — to trip or momentarily lose balance; a synonym of falter.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of falter: Continue, Persevere, Endure.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Unprecedented (अभूतपूर्व): Familiar (परिचित)

2. Unsure (अनिश्चित): Certain (निश्चित), Sure (पक्का)

3. Upright (ईमानदार): Corrupt (भ्रष्ट), Dishonest (बेईमान)

4. Usurp (हड़पना): Restore (वापस करना), Surrender (समर्पण करना)

5. Utterly (पूरी तरह): Minimally (न्यूनतम), Slightly (थोड़ा)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Dispatch."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Acquire.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Dispatch" means to send off promptly to a destination for a purpose. (भेजना)

 

• "Acquire" means to gain possession of something through effort or purchase. It is therefore the correct antonym. (प्राप्त करना)

◦ Example: The firm plans to acquire a smaller rival to strengthen its position in the market.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Send (भेजना) — to cause something to go to a destination; a synonym of dispatch.

• Option 2: Forward (अग्रेषित करना) — to send something on further; a synonym of dispatch.

• Option 3: Transmit (प्रसारित करना) — to pass something on to another place; a synonym of dispatch.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of dispatch: Retain, Keep, Receive.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Vacillate (डगमगाना): Decide (निर्णय लेना), Resolve (निश्चित करना)

2. Vain (घमंडी/अहंकारी): Humble (नम्र), Modest (विनम्र)

3. Vehement (तीव्र/जोरदार): Mild (मंद), Gentle (कोमल)

4. Venerable (आदरणीय): Immature (अपरिपक्व), Disrespectful (अनादरपूर्ण)

5. Venerate (सम्मान करना): Despise (घृणा करना), Disrespect (अनादर करना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Judicious".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Irrational.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Judicious" means having or showing good judgment; sensible. (विवेकपूर्ण)

◦ Example: The judge made a judicious decision after carefully weighing all the evidence presented during the trial.

 

• "Irrational" means not logical or reasonable; lacking sound judgment, and is therefore the correct antonym. (अतार्किक)

◦ Example: Panic often leads investors to make irrational decisions that hurt their long-term financial interests.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Wise (बुद्धिमान): having or showing good judgment from experience — a synonym of judicious, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण): acting with care and thought for the future — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Sensible (समझदार): having or showing good sense — close in sense to judicious.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of judicious: Prudent, Sensible, Wise, Discerning, Sound.

• Synonyms of irrational: Illogical, Unreasonable, Absurd, Senseless.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Venom (जहर): Benevolent (दयालुता), Antidote (विषनाशक)

2. Veracity (सत्यता): Falsehood (असत्य), Dishonesty (बेईमानी)

3. Veracity (सत्यता): Falsehood (असत्य), Lie (झूठ)

4. Veteran (अनुभवी): Novice (नवसिखुआ), Beginner (शुरुआती)

5. Vexatious (कष्टदायक / तंग करने वाला): Pleasant (सुखद), Comforting (आरामदायक)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Slender."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Stout.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Slender" means gracefully thin; slim in build. (पतला)

 

• "Stout" means somewhat fat or thickset in build. It is therefore the correct antonym. (मोटा)

◦ Example: The stout old man struggled to climb the steep staircase to the second floor.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Lean (दुबला-पतला) — thin but healthy and fit; a synonym of slender.

• Option 2: Thin (दुबला) — having little bodily fat; a synonym of slender.

• Option 4: Slim (पतला/छरहरा) — gracefully thin in build; a synonym of slender.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of slender: Thick, Fat, Plump.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Vigilant (सतर्क): Negligent (लापरवाह)

2. Vilify (बदनाम करना): Commend (प्रशंसा करना), Praise (सराहना)

3. Vindicate (निर्दोष साबित करना): Accuse (आरोप लगाना), Blame (दोष देना)

4. Violent (हिंसक): Gentle (कोमल), Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण)

5. Vivacious (चंचल): Dull (नीरस), Lifeless (निष्प्राण)
